title.narrative: 1. With support from UNICEF, the government drafted Career Education and Skills Framework. The career education, skills development framework provides guidance on career education and skills development interventions for in- and out of school adolescents. UNICEF continues to support MoE with capacity building for guidance and counselling teachers to ensure compliance with protective legal instruments for children, career guidance for learners and provision of psycho-social support and refferal to services.
